ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the left figure is a schematic diagram of the terrain and location near the Iberian Peninsula; place C is located in the northwestern part of the peninsula, close to the Atlantic Ocean, and also near an area of relatively high terrain. The right figure shows three line graphs of changes in multi-year average monthly precipitation, among which line graph No. ③ has very high precipitation in January—February and November—December, and precipitation clearly decreases in summer from June—August; compared with ① and ②, line graph No. ③ has the largest overall precipitation and the most prominent characteristic of more rain in winter. Then reason: place C is located in the northwestern part of the peninsula, is clearly affected by moist westerlies from the Atlantic Ocean, and also has an orographic uplift effect, so winter precipitation should be relatively abundant; at the same time, this region still shows a Mediterranean-style seasonal characteristic of being relatively dry in summer. It best matches line graph No. ③ in the right figure, which has “the most winter precipitation, little summer precipitation, and relatively large annual precipitation.” Therefore, place C corresponds to precipitation line graph No. ③.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：左图丙地在半岛西北部近大西洋，且靠近高地；右图③线在1—2月和11—12月降水很高，夏季6—8月降水很低。再推理：丙地受大西洋湿润西风和地形抬升影响，冬季降水应最多，同时夏季仍有地中海式干燥特征。因此应选择全年降水量最大、冬雨最显著的③号折线。
